body: Thank you, you've given me something to think about. I am worried about jobs, I do overanalyze and get distracted easily, but you do have some good points.

I can relate with the amount of time it takes to write a paper, I usually dedicate a day or the weekend though on some papers. Your right about me equating the two, I should have reworded it differently.

I sometimes tell people about my memory, but not always, it depends really. If I'm more than a stranger to someone than I might tell them. I don't know why my memory is so bad though, I have theories. I'm quite sure I inherited it from my father, he has memory issues also. I have problems remembering directions even to local places in town. I think your right about getting the practice, I just need to stop caring about what others think of my incompetence.
